title: fix(fields): a pick says why it kept a filled amount, the opening fill stops waiting on an unreadable parent, and a code-plus-amount pick copies both
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDHJBvzScLgkhKgms97sNuU)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhoBbwh8URjwQHde8v

Refs #36412
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户可见变化：选产品时，若价格栏已有数值且币种不同，原值保留并在下方说明；新建明细时上级币种读不到也不再一直卡住，描述照常带出、单价留空并说明；产品自带币种和价格一起带出时，两者都会填上。
- 为什么做：这是「选产品不跨币种抄价格」那张卡留下的四个后续问题，替多币种发票的使用者补齐提示和漏填。
- 出错会怎样：只影响选取关联记录时自动带出的金额和提示文字，已填的数值不会被改动；可以直接撤回这一个合并。
- 要你做什么：无（「改币种后保留金额并提示」那一项未在本次实现，交席位安排后续）。

## What changes

Items 1–4 of the card and To-do 5. The ruling item (comment 7118795825) is not built here: see "Ruling item" below.

- **Item 1, a re-pick over a filled cell says why (closed: behaviour route, no describe narrowed).** A withheld value now records `held`, the value its target held at the pick. The note shows while the target still holds that value (empty, or the earlier value a re-pick or an `overwrite: true` pair left in place: `withheldStillStands`), on the grid and on the record face, and ends "Unit Price still holds its earlier value." Editing the target ends the note.
- **Item 2, the opening fill's wait is bounded (closed).** `useFollowedParentRead` (`followedParentRow.ts`) reports where the parent read stands: `none`, `pending`, `read`, or `unread` (the read failed or answered no row, the source has no `findOne`, or no parent object is stamped). `LookupField` waits only while it is `pending`. An `unread` parent puts a following amount in the new `AmountCurrency` kind `unread`: it is withheld with the reason `targetCurrencyUnread` ("the currency here could not be read"), and every target that does not depend on currency (the description) fills.
- **Item 3, every record-form host is stamped (closed by measurement plus a pin).** Measured on `7a5ae65e54e`: the only writer of `onAutofill` is the form renderer, and every record-form layout draws through `gateFormFields` → `stampRecordFormFields`: `ObjectForm` simple and sectioned arms, `DrawerForm`, `ModalForm`, `TabbedForm`, `WizardForm`, and the forms drawn through `ObjectForm` (`MasterDetailForm` header and line form, `EmbeddableForm`). The record page's body tables (`RecordBodyTableEditor`) are a line-item grid and judge their own picks; the record page's own field editing hands no `onAutofill`, so it fills nothing. No host needed a change; the `recordFormStamp.ts` header now lists the hosts and names the one that keeps the old behaviour: a standalone `form` node (the `@object-ui/components` form renderer outside these hosts), which holds no object field map.
- **Item 4, an amount is judged with this pick's own code write applied (closed).** `planDeclaredLookupAutofill` and the grid's `planLookupAutofill` now collect every value a pick would write (`declaredPickWrites`, the same-named copy) and judge them together (`judgePickWrites`): `targetCurrency` is handed the pick's writes, and `amountCurrencyOf`'s new third argument lays a write to the amount's own code field on the record before resolving. A parent path is not overlaid (a parent's code is not the record's to write). Pinned through the grid and through `ObjectForm`.
- i18n: two sentences, `lookup.autofillCurrencyUnread` and `lookup.autofillKept`, in all 11 packs (zh-Hant generated) and in `FIELD_DEFAULTS`.
- One changeset: `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` (the last for the comment in `recordFormStamp.ts`), all `patch`.

## Ruling item (not built here)

Not built, so this PR carries `Refs #36412` and leaves the card open. Two reasons. First, size: items 1–4 already change 714 lines, and the ruling item needs a copied-under record and a per-render re-judgement on both hosts plus a sentence in 11 packs and its pins, which puts the total past the 900-line bound. Second, one visible case the ruling does not settle: a withheld note refreshed to a new record currency that equals the picked amount's own currency (the reason no longer holds, and the target is still empty) could drop the note, keep the old wording, or say something new. Follow-up: none filed; the seat decides.

## Tests

Tests on head `12d8d3bb3bd`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/ packages/plugin-form/ packages/i18n/` (Test Files 682 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 9796 passed, 21 skipped); `type-check` of `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/i18n` exit 0.

<details><summary>New pins and ablations</summary>

- `GridField.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx`, describe "(objectstack#36412)", 8 tests: `amountCurrencyOf` reads the pick's code write, not a parent's; the same-named copy and declared pairs copy a code and the price in it onto a fresh line (control: a grid drawing no code column withholds the price; a code the record holds is kept and judges the price); a withheld value over a filled target carries `held` (control: over an empty one it does not); through the grid, a fresh line fills code and price with no note (control: no code column, "no currency is chosen"), a pick over a filled JPY cell keeps 80 and says so until the cell is edited (control: an empty cell's note has no kept sentence).
- `ObjectForm.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx`, describe "(objectstack#36412)", 13 tests: an `overwrite: true` pick over a filled JPY price keeps it and says so (control: a EUR quote replaces it, no note); a code-plus-price pick fills both on a quote with no code (control: a pick without the code pair says no currency is chosen); the opening fill does not wait on a failed parent read or a source with no `findOne`, fills the description and says the currency could not be read (control: an answering read fills the price); each of six layouts (simple flat, simple sections, drawer, modal, tabbed, wizard) withholds a EUR price from a JPY quote and fills a EUR one.
- Ablations on the committed tree, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, vitest aliasing `@object-ui/*` to `src` (no dist between mutation and run), each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - item 4, `lookupAutofill.ts` anchor `const refused = judgeCopy(currency, c, writes);` x1 to x0 (writes not handed): Tests 4 failed, 56 passed (60); restored blob `faf38ecb05a9`.
  - item 2, `LookupField.tsx` anchor `const followedParentPending = followedParentState === 'pending';` x1 to x0 (an unread parent waits again): Tests 2 failed, 26 passed (28); restored blob `4717859dc284`.
  - item 1, `withheldStillStands` reduced to "the target is empty": Tests 2 failed, 58 passed (60); restored blob `faf38ecb05a9`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- N9 (record-page editor re-renders): not measured. This diff adds no work per render there; the new work runs once per pick.
- Addendum 7088192432 is kept as it is: a record that names no parent and holds no code still gets "no currency is chosen here yet".
- A standalone `form` node with a lookup carrying `lookupAutofill` in its field carrier still copies across currencies. Making it judge needs a change in `@object-ui/components` (outside this card's surface) or narrowing the `FieldSchema.lookupAutofill` describe in `packages/spec`; neither is done here, and it is reported to the seat.
- `followedParentRow.ts`: a failed read now records an answer with no row instead of clearing the answer. The amount box (`CurrencyField`) reads the same record either way.

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 41 commands at `12d8d3bb3bd`; 40 ran with exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` is NOT MEASURED (SIGKILL beside the package suite, then exit 124 at the 590 s limit under the lock; its closure-budget case needs a console build) and is left to CI. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 41 derived, 40 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `ui` `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- `overlap-check` before every push: VERDICT clean exit 0.

</details>

Read first, by risk: (1) `judgePickWrites` and `withCodeWrite` in `lookupAutofill.ts`; (2) `useFollowedParentRead` in `followedParentRow.ts` and its use in `LookupField.tsx`; (3) `withheldStillStands` at the two note sites.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx -t 36412` passes 13 tests; in it, a quote with no code picks a EUR product and holds `EUR` and `100`.
